900.2.10(769).explanation: Exception R 769 has no site specific provisions. It lists former City of Toronto by-laws 704-79, 844-79, 535-80 and 162-84 as prevailing by-laws, the last for named addresses on Greenwood, Lount, Quarry, Sandstone, Torbrick, Unity and Valifor.
